name: Macaroni Salad
description: A classic macaroni salad with tuna, ham, and cheddar cheese, mixed with Miracle Whip and spices.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Let cool.
Cut up celery, cheese, tuna, and ham into small pieces.
Combine cooled macaroni with the tuna mixture.
Add enough Miracle Whip to moisten the salad.
Sprinkle with parsley flakes and paprika.
Mix well and serve.

keywords: macaroni salad, tuna salad, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Macaroni Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting macaroni and meat casserole topped with cheese and baked until golden.
recipeIngredient: 1 to 2 cups grated cheese (e.g., cheddar, mozzarella, Monterey Jack)

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the macaroni, drain and set aside.
Brown hamburger, adding onions, green pepper and mushrooms.
Add the spices, ketchup and tomatoes. Reduce heat and simmer.
Place the macaroni and meat mixture in a large casserole dish and mix.
Spoon the mushroom soup across the top, covering the casserole.
Sprinkle the cheese on top.
Cover and bake in 350°F oven for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: macaroni casserole, cheesy pasta bake, comfort food

_similar.name: Macaroni Ham Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting macaroni and ham casserole topped with cheddar cheese and crushed sour cream and onion potato chips.
recipeIngredient: 1 to 1¼ cups (250 to 375 mL) grated cheddar cheese
Crushed sour cream and onion flavoured potato chips for topping

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Cook the macaroni in boiling water, then drain and mix in cubed ham.
Melt margarine in a saucepan and mix in the flour. Add in the milk and stir constantly over medium heat until the mixture is thick and smooth.
Mix the sauce with the macaroni and ham, then pour into a greased casserole dish.
Add salt and pepper to taste, and stir in about ¾ of the grated cheddar cheese.
Sprinkle the remaining cheddar cheese on top.
Top with crushed sour cream and onion flavoured potato chips.
Bake at 350°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the casserole is bubbling.

_similar.keywords: macaroni casserole, ham and cheese, comfort food

_similar.name: Pasta Salad
_similar.description: A colorful pasta salad with penne or spiral pasta, vegetables, feta cheese, and a tangy herb dressing.
recipeIngredient: ½ bag penne or spiral pasta

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the pasta according to package instructions, then drain and cool.
Add chopped green pepper, tomatoes, green onions, and sliced black olives to the cooled pasta.
Crumble the feta cheese into the pasta mixture.
Pour the Classic Herb dressing over the salad and toss to combine.

_similar.keywords: pasta salad, feta cheese, herb dressing, vegetable salad

_similar.name: Mexican Salad
_similar.description: A hearty and flavorful salad with kidney beans, lentils, and low-fat cheese, topped with salsa and served with taco chips.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup low-fat cheese (mozzarella or cheddar or combination)

recipeInstructions.text: Combine kidney beans, lentils, diced tomato, shredded lettuce, chopped green pepper, low-fat cheese, and green onions in a large bowl.
Toss the salad with Catalina dressing until well coated.
Top the salad with salsa.
Serve immediately with taco chips on the side.

_similar.keywords: Mexican salad, bean salad, taco chips

_similar.name: Tomato Macaroni Soup
_similar.description: A hearty and comforting soup featuring macaroni, vegetables, and a rich tomato broth.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute onion, celery, and carrot in oil until tender.
Add stock, juice, and water. Bring to a boil.
Add pasta and cook until tender.
Add garlic salt and Worcestershire sauce.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

_similar.keywords: tomato macaroni soup, comfort food, pasta soup
